caption:
Quarterly BAS due dates. Screenshot this.

July – September → 28 October
October – December → 28 February
January – March → 28 April
April – June → 28 July

The October – December one is the next to land: 28 February. It already has an extra month built in, so there's no further extension for it.

For the other quarters, lodging online or through a registered tax or BAS agent can give you extra time.

Lodge late and a failure-to-lodge penalty can apply: one penalty unit ($364 since 1 July 2026) for each 28 days or part, up to five, for small entities. Interest also runs on anything unpaid.

Can't pay on time? Lodging on time anyway stops the lodgment penalty from building.

Do you lodge your own BAS or use an agent?
